examples.hanzi: 这道菜极其好吃，我吃了两碗饭。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài jíqí hǎochī, wǒ chī le liǎng wǎn fàn.
examples.english: This dish is extremely tasty, and I ate two bowls of rice.

examples.pinyin: Shāndǐng shàng de fēngjǐng jíqí měilì.
examples.english: The view from the mountaintop is extremely beautiful.

examples.hanzi: 师傅，请问去火车站怎么走？
examples.pinyin: Shīfu, qǐngwèn qù huǒchēzhàn zěnme zǒu?
examples.english: Excuse me, driver, how do I get to the train station?

examples.hanzi: 他跟着老师傅学了三年做菜。
examples.pinyin: Tā gēnzhe lǎo shīfu xué le sān nián zuòcài.
examples.english: He studied cooking under an old master for three years.

examples.hanzi: 这条地铁线路很方便。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo dìtiě xiànlù hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: This subway line is very convenient.

examples.hanzi: 电工正在检查家里的线路。
examples.pinyin: Diàngōng zhèngzài jiǎnchá jiālǐ de xiànlù.
examples.english: The electrician is checking the wiring at home.

examples.hanzi: 早餐我想吃香肠和鸡蛋。
examples.pinyin: Zǎocān wǒ xiǎng chī xiāngcháng hé jīdàn.
examples.english: For breakfast I'd like sausage and eggs.

examples.hanzi: 这家店的香肠是自己做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de xiāngcháng shì zìjǐ zuò de.
examples.english: The sausages at this shop are homemade.

examples.hanzi: 我们的车坏了，只能叫拖车。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de chē huài le, zhǐ néng jiào tuōchē.
examples.english: Our car broke down, so we had to call a tow truck.

examples.hanzi: 这辆拖车可以拖很重的货物。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng tuōchē kěyǐ tuō hěn zhòng de huòwù.
examples.english: This trailer can haul very heavy cargo.

examples.hanzi: 工人们在检修这些机械。
examples.pinyin: Gōngrénmen zài jiǎnxiū zhèxiē jīxiè.
examples.english: The workers are repairing this machinery.

examples.hanzi: 他在一家机械厂工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yì jiā jīxiè chǎng gōngzuò.
examples.english: He works at a machinery factory.

examples.hanzi: 我想喝一杯冰可乐。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē yì bēi bīng kělè.
examples.english: I'd like a glass of iced cola.

examples.hanzi: 汉堡配可乐是很多人的最爱。
examples.pinyin: Hànbǎo pèi kělè shì hěn duō rén de zuì'ài.
examples.english: A burger with cola is a favorite for many people.

examples.hanzi: 我们想和家人共度春节。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiǎng hé jiārén gòngdù Chūnjié.
examples.english: We'd like to spend the Spring Festival with our family.

examples.hanzi: 他们将共度一个难忘的夜晚。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen jiāng gòngdù yí ge nánwàng de yèwǎn.
examples.english: They will spend an unforgettable evening together.

examples.hanzi: 他把电话号码写在纸条上。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ diànhuà hàomǎ xiě zài zhǐtiáo shàng.
examples.english: He wrote the phone number on a slip of paper.

examples.hanzi: 课堂上同学们互相传纸条。
examples.pinyin: Kètáng shàng tóngxuémen hùxiāng chuán zhǐtiáo.
examples.english: Classmates pass notes to each other in class.

examples.hanzi: 空气污染让很多人感到担心。
examples.pinyin: Kōngqì wūrǎn ràng hěn duō rén gǎndào dānxīn.
examples.english: Air pollution worries many people.

examples.hanzi: 请不要污染我们的河流。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào wūrǎn wǒmen de héliú.
examples.english: Please don't pollute our rivers.

examples.hanzi: 警察拘留了他两天。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá jūliú le tā liǎng tiān.
examples.english: The police detained him for two days.

examples.hanzi: 他因为打架被拘留了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi dǎjià bèi jūliú le.
examples.english: He was detained for fighting.

examples.hanzi: 我下定决心每天跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiàdìng juéxīn měi tiān pǎobù.
examples.english: I've made up my mind to run every day.

examples.hanzi: 她有决心把这件事做好。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu juéxīn bǎ zhè jiàn shì zuò hǎo.
examples.english: She is determined to do this well.

examples.hanzi: 我坚信他会成功。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiānxìn tā huì chénggōng.
examples.english: I firmly believe he will succeed.

examples.hanzi: 大家都坚信明天会更好。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu jiānxìn míngtiān huì gèng hǎo.
examples.english: Everyone firmly believes tomorrow will be better.

examples.hanzi: 前面有人，快刹车！
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn yǒu rén, kuài shāchē!
examples.english: There's someone ahead, brake quickly!

examples.hanzi: 这辆车的刹车有点儿问题。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de shāchē yǒudiǎnr wèntí.
examples.english: There's a small problem with this car's brakes.

examples.hanzi: 他从事软件开发已经五年了。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóngshì ruǎnjiàn kāifā yǐjīng wǔ nián le.
examples.english: He has been engaged in software development for five years.

examples.hanzi: 她想从事医疗工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng cóngshì yīliáo gōngzuò.
examples.english: She wants to work in the medical field.

examples.hanzi: 我们的学校位于一条安静的街上。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de xuéxiào wèiyú yì tiáo ānjìng de jiē shàng.
examples.english: Our school is located on a quiet street.

examples.hanzi: 这座城市位于海边。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì wèiyú hǎibiān.
examples.english: This city is situated by the sea.

examples.hanzi: 周末我们带孩子去看马戏团表演。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen dài háizi qù kàn mǎxìtuán biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: On the weekend we take the kids to watch a circus show.

examples.hanzi: 马戏团的小丑逗得大家哈哈大笑。
examples.pinyin: Mǎxìtuán de xiǎochǒu dòu de dàjiā hāhā dà xiào.
examples.english: The circus clown made everyone burst out laughing.

examples.hanzi: 病毒通过空气传播。
examples.pinyin: Bìngdú tōngguò kōngqì chuánbō.
examples.english: The virus spreads through the air.

examples.hanzi: 好的习惯会在家庭里传播。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo de xíguàn huì zài jiātíng lǐ chuánbō.
examples.english: Good habits spread within a family.

examples.hanzi: 每当夜晚来临，他就会拉小提琴。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng yèwǎn láilín, tā jiù huì lā xiǎotíqín.
examples.english: Whenever night falls, he plays the violin.

examples.hanzi: 每当我难过的时候，朋友都会陪着我。
examples.pinyin: Měidāng wǒ nánguò de shíhou, péngyou dōu huì péizhe wǒ.
examples.english: Every time I feel down, my friends keep me company.

examples.hanzi: 幸好我们提前出发了，没有迟到。
examples.pinyin: Xìnghǎo wǒmen tíqián chūfā le, méiyǒu chídào.
examples.english: Luckily we set off early and weren't late.

examples.hanzi: 幸好没人受伤。
examples.pinyin: Xìnghǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Fortunately, nobody was hurt.

examples.hanzi: 足球比赛需要三名裁判。
examples.pinyin: Zúqiú bǐsài xūyào sān míng cáipàn.
examples.english: A soccer match needs three referees.

examples.hanzi: 他对裁判的决定不满意。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì cáipàn de juédìng bù mǎnyì.
examples.english: He was unhappy with the referee's decision.

examples.hanzi: 那位商人在全国开了很多家店。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi shāngrén zài quánguó kāi le hěn duō jiā diàn.
examples.english: That businessman has opened many shops across the country.

examples.hanzi: 古代的商人经常走丝绸之路。
examples.pinyin: Gǔdài de shāngrén jīngcháng zǒu sīchóu zhī lù.
examples.english: Merchants in ancient times often traveled the Silk Road.

examples.hanzi: 这个想法很大胆，但很有创意。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎngfǎ hěn dàdǎn, dàn hěn yǒu chuàngyì.
examples.english: This idea is bold but very creative.

examples.hanzi: 你就大胆地试一试吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiù dàdǎn de shì yi shì ba.
examples.english: Go ahead and give it a bold try.

examples.hanzi: 这家餐厅雇用了很多年轻人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng gùyòng le hěn duō niánqīngrén.
examples.english: This restaurant employs many young people.

examples.hanzi: 我们不雇用没有经验的人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bù gùyòng méiyǒu jīngyàn de rén.
examples.english: We don't hire people without experience.

examples.hanzi: 她喜欢一边做饭一边歌唱。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan yìbiān zuòfàn yìbiān gēchàng.
examples.english: She likes singing while she cooks.

examples.hanzi: 鸟儿在树上欢快地歌唱。
examples.pinyin: Niǎor zài shù shàng huānkuài de gēchàng.
examples.english: Birds sing cheerfully in the trees.

examples.hanzi: 他很快就融入了新的班级。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn kuài jiù róngrù le xīn de bānjí.
examples.english: He quickly fit into his new class.

examples.hanzi: 颜色应该融入整个画面。
examples.pinyin: Yánsè yīnggāi róngrù zhěng ge huàmiàn.
examples.english: The colors should blend into the whole picture.

examples.hanzi: 这个月我花钱太多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuè wǒ huāqián tài duō le.
examples.english: I spent too much money this month.

examples.hanzi: 他不喜欢在衣服上花钱。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuan zài yīfu shàng huāqián.
examples.english: He doesn't like spending money on clothes.

examples.hanzi: 你得避开中午最热的时候出门。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi bìkāi zhōngwǔ zuì rè de shíhou chūmén.
examples.english: You should avoid going out during the hottest part of noon.

examples.hanzi: 他故意避开了我的目光。
examples.pinyin: Tā gùyì bìkāi le wǒ de mùguāng.
examples.english: He deliberately avoided my gaze.

examples.hanzi: 保安每小时在小区里巡逻一次。
examples.pinyin: Bǎo'ān měi xiǎoshí zài xiǎoqū lǐ xúnluó yí cì.
examples.english: The security guard patrols the neighborhood once an hour.

examples.hanzi: 海边有救生员巡逻。
examples.pinyin: Hǎibiān yǒu jiùshēngyuán xúnluó.
examples.english: Lifeguards patrol the beach.

examples.hanzi: 小小的房间里放着一张床。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxiǎo de fángjiān lǐ fàngzhe yì zhāng chuáng.
examples.english: A small bed sits in the tiny room.

examples.hanzi: 别看他年纪小小的，懂的可多了。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn tā niánjì xiǎoxiǎo de, dǒng de kě duō le.
examples.english: Though he's little, he knows a lot.

examples.hanzi: 公共场所不允许吸烟。
examples.pinyin: Gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ bù yǔnxǔ xīyān.
examples.english: Smoking is not allowed in public places.

examples.hanzi: 医生劝他不要再吸烟了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng quàn tā bú yào zài xīyān le.
examples.english: The doctor advised him to stop smoking.

examples.hanzi: 这个国家分裂成了两个部分。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā fēnliè chéng le liǎng ge bùfen.
examples.english: This country split into two parts.

examples.hanzi: 细胞会不断分裂和生长。
examples.pinyin: Xìbāo huì búduàn fēnliè hé shēngzhǎng.
examples.english: Cells keep dividing and growing.

examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí wǒ yòng bǐjìběn jì bǐjì.
examples.english: In class I take notes in my notebook.

examples.hanzi: 这台笔记本很轻，方便带出门。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái bǐjìběn hěn qīng, fāngbiàn dài chūmén.
examples.english: This laptop is light and easy to take out.

examples.hanzi: 我早餐喜欢吃一根香蕉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎocān xǐhuan chī yì gēn xiāngjiāo.
examples.english: I like eating a banana for breakfast.

examples.hanzi: 这串香蕉还没熟。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chuàn xiāngjiāo hái méi shú.
examples.english: This bunch of bananas isn't ripe yet.

examples.pinyin: Nà wèi jūnguān zhèngzài jiǎnchá shìbīng de zhuāngbèi.
examples.english: That officer is inspecting the soldiers' equipment.

examples.hanzi: 我叔叔退休前是一名军官。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shūshu tuìxiū qián shì yì míng jūnguān.
examples.english: My uncle was an officer before he retired.

examples.hanzi: 有人侵入了公司的电脑系统。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén qīnrù le gōngsī de diànnǎo xìtǒng.
examples.english: Someone broke into the company's computer system.

examples.hanzi: 暴风雨侵入了海边的小镇。
examples.pinyin: Bàofēngyǔ qīnrù le hǎibiān de xiǎozhèn.
examples.english: The storm swept into the seaside town.

examples.hanzi: 普通家用电的电压是二百二十伏特。
examples.pinyin: Pǔtōng jiāyòng diàn de diànyā shì èrbǎi èrshí fútè.
examples.english: The voltage of ordinary household electricity is 220 volts.

examples.hanzi: 这块电池只有一点五伏特。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài diànchí zhǐyǒu yì diǎn wǔ fútè.
examples.english: This battery is only 1.5 volts.

examples.hanzi: 请记得冲马桶。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng jìde chōng mǎtǒng.
examples.english: Please remember to flush the toilet.

examples.hanzi: 马桶坏了，要找人来修。
examples.pinyin: Mǎtǒng huài le, yào zhǎo rén lái xiū.
examples.english: The toilet is broken, so we need to get someone to fix it.

examples.hanzi: 那个少年每天骑车去上学。
examples.pinyin: Nàge shàonián měi tiān qí chē qù shàngxué.
examples.english: That boy rides a bike to school every day.

examples.hanzi: 少年时期的他非常爱读书。
examples.pinyin: Shàonián shíqī de tā fēicháng ài dúshū.
examples.english: In his youth he loved reading very much.

examples.hanzi: 深夜的噪音让邻居很生气。
examples.pinyin: Shēnyè de zàoyīn ràng línjū hěn shēngqì.
examples.english: The late-night noise made the neighbors very angry.

examples.hanzi: 这台冰箱几乎没有噪音。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái bīngxiāng jīhū méiyǒu zàoyīn.
examples.english: This refrigerator makes almost no noise.

examples.hanzi: 你把要买的东西写在单子上吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bǎ yào mǎi de dōngxi xiě zài dānzǐ shàng ba.
examples.english: Write the things you need to buy on the list.

examples.hanzi: 我把新床单子铺好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ xīn chuángdānzǐ pūhǎo le.
examples.english: I've put on the new bed sheet.

examples.hanzi: 这些把戏骗不了我。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē bǎxì piàn bu liǎo wǒ.
examples.english: These tricks can't fool me.

examples.hanzi: 马戏团里有很多精彩的把戏。
examples.pinyin: Mǎxìtuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō jīngcǎi de bǎxì.
examples.english: The circus has many wonderful tricks.

examples.hanzi: 游客从各地来到这座城市。
examples.pinyin: Yóukè cóng gèdì lái dào zhè zuò chéngshì.
examples.english: Tourists come to this city from all over.

examples.hanzi: 各地的人口味都不一样。
examples.pinyin: Gèdì de rén kǒuwèi dōu bù yíyàng.
examples.english: People's tastes differ from region to region.

examples.hanzi: 新年到了，我们一起迎接新的一年。
examples.pinyin: Xīnnián dào le, wǒmen yìqǐ yíngjiē xīn de yì nián.
examples.english: The New Year has arrived, so let's welcome it together.

examples.hanzi: 校长在门口迎接新同学。
examples.pinyin: Xiàozhǎng zài ménkǒu yíngjiē xīn tóngxué.
examples.english: The principal greets the new students at the gate.

examples.hanzi: 这个月手头有点紧，先不买了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yuè shǒutóu yǒudiǎn jǐn, xiān bù mǎi le.
examples.english: Money is tight this month, so I won't buy it for now.

examples.hanzi: 我手头没有带笔，你有吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shǒutóu méiyǒu dài bǐ, nǐ yǒu ma?
examples.english: I don't have a pen on hand, do you?

examples.hanzi: 我头痛，想早点休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóutòng, xiǎng zǎodiǎn xiūxi.
examples.english: I have a headache and want to rest early.

examples.hanzi: 他经常头痛，应该去看医生。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīngcháng tóutòng, yīnggāi qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: He often has headaches and should see a doctor.

examples.hanzi: 蝴蝶落在花朵上。
examples.pinyin: Húdié luò zài huāduǒ shàng.
examples.english: A butterfly landed on the flower.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们追着蝴蝶跑。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zhuīzhe húdié pǎo.
examples.english: The kids ran chasing the butterfly.

examples.hanzi: 宝宝吃坏了东西，一直在呕吐。
examples.pinyin: Bǎobao chī huài le dōngxi, yìzhí zài ǒutù.
examples.english: The baby ate something bad and keeps vomiting.

examples.hanzi: 吃了这种药，有人会感到呕吐。
examples.pinyin: Chī le zhè zhǒng yào, yǒu rén huì gǎndào ǒutù.
examples.english: Some people feel nauseous after taking this medicine.

examples.hanzi: 请给“环保”下一个定义。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi “huánbǎo” xià yí ge dìngyì.
examples.english: Please give a definition of “environmental protection”.

examples.hanzi: 不同的人对幸福的定义不一样。
examples.pinyin: Bùtóng de rén duì xìngfú de dìngyì bù yíyàng.
examples.english: Different people define happiness differently.

examples.hanzi: 我不但没睡好，反而更累了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ búdàn méi shuì hǎo, fǎn'ér gèng lèi le.
examples.english: Not only did I not sleep well, I'm even more tired.

examples.hanzi: 你这样说，反而让他更难过。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhèyàng shuō, fǎn'ér ràng tā gèng nánguò.
examples.english: Saying it like that actually upset him more.
